title: ze_payload_swarm
description:
ZE_PAYLOAD_SWARM

<< Map Features >>

- 1 Level
- 2 Difficulties
- 4 Human Items
- Drivable Helicopter on Set Path
- Open Map

<< Map Description >>

- Experience a unique new twist on the zombie escape formula in this open style map. 

- The humans must push a mine-cart across the map and onto an elevator, then activate and defend three power cabinets. 

- Keep these cabinets powered and the elevator rising—fail, and the journey ends. You have 6 minutes to get the elevator to reach the top, and then extract to 2 randomly chosen extraction zones.

- Strategic teamwork is crucial. Four special items, randomly chosen at fixed spawn points, give humans a fighting chance:

Protection Circle: Repels nearby zombies.
Fire Barrel: Explodes and ignites invading zombies.
Wall: Temporarily blocks movement.
Airstrike: Calls for an Airstrike on location.

- Fly a helicopter forwards and backwards along set path, this offers aerial support, zombie spotting, and a climbable rope for quick escapes. 

- Zombie spawns are scattered throughout the environment, and the map's difficulty scales with their health.

Starting at:

Casual : 600 HP
Challenge : 800 HP

These values are subject to change after testing and feedback.

<< Server Settings >>

Recommended server settings for Intended map experience:

zr_infect_spawn_mz_ratio 7
zr_infect_spawn_time_max 16
zr_infect_spawn_time_min 14
zr_respawn_delay 0
zr_infect_spawn_type 1

The map was designed with these settings in mind. However servers can use whatever settings they wish.
